payload.reason: The evidence indicates that pairwise ranking models outperform classification models in cross-corpus and cross-lingual evaluations, which is why classification-based models were not used for the zero-shot experiments.

claims.text: Pairwise ranking models perform better than classification models in cross-corpus and cross-lingual evaluations.
Zero-shot cross-lingual transfer is possible with pairwise ranking models, which supports their use over classification models.
The experiments showed that classification models achieved lower performance compared to pairwise ranking models in the evaluated scenarios.
